title: 把机器人的摘句核对做成一个包
description: 微信机器人里逐字核对摘句的代码，单独做成了一个零依赖的 Python 包。它留下什么、丢掉什么，为什么不用第二个模型当裁判，以及从打 tag 到发上 PyPI 怎么走。
content:
我的微信问答机器人只许大模型用资料里的原句回答，每一句发出去之前都要经过代码核对。为什么这样做，我在《只许大模型摘原句的问答机器人》里写过。

这段核对代码原来在机器人的 wxbot/rag.py 里，和检索、校区标签、微信排版混在一起。这个周末我把它抽出来，做成了 quotegate，发到了 PyPI，MIT 许可证。这篇讲哪些东西放进了包里，哪些留在外面。

它做什么

让模型按 [2] 原文里的一句话 这样的格式回答。check() 读这些行，只有那句话确实在第 2 段资料里、单独拿出来也读得通，才留下：

from quotegate import Passage, check

passages = [
    Passage("Special consideration\nApply online within two working days of the due date. "
            "This must include supporting documents.", title="Special consideration"),
]
reply = "[1] Apply online within two working days\n[1] This must include supporting documents"

result = check(reply, passages)
result.status    # "ok"
result.kept      # [Quote(passage=1, text="Apply online within two working days of the due date.", start=22, end=75)]
result.dropped   # [Dropped(passage=1, quote="This must include supporting documents.", reason="needs context")]


第一句被扩展成它所在的整句话。第二句确实在资料里，但它以 “This” 开头，指的是读者看不到的上一句，所以被丢掉，并写明原因。

status 不是 "ok" 的时候，模型给的东西一句都不该发。另外四种状态说明原因：模型说不知道、一句都没摘、摘的都不在资料里、在资料里但单独读不通。机器人遇到这些就把问题转给我。

哪些会被丢掉

大部分规则来自机器人差点发出去的真实回复：


  
    
      原因
      例子
    
  
  
    
      not found
      改写过的句子，或者标错了是第几段
    
    
      needs context
      以 “This must…”、“However”、“不，” 开头；以 “:” 或 “；并且” 结尾
    
    
      list item
      “If you don’t meet any of the requirements above:” 下面的 “- you must contact ISP”
    
    
      table row
      “Oct intake | OCT-MY-01 | 6 Jan”，但没有表头
    
    
      past year
      2026 年读到 “From 2022 exams are online”
    
    
      a question
      资料自己的 FAQ 问题
    
  


模型也不一定照格式来。解析每一行的正则接受 【2†L9-L12】、全角括号、前面带圆点、数字后面带冒号，这些我都在免费模型的回复里见过。

断句需要两个开关。默认换行就是一句结束，因为网页里换行通常是标题或列表项。公众号文章和 PDF 里的文字会在句子中间换行，这类资料标 soft_breaks=True。英文句号只有后面跟空白才算句子结束，所以 “50.0” 和 “monash.edu” 不会被拆开。

哪些留在外面

不用模型。 检查 RAG 回答常见的办法，是再让一个模型判断每个说法有没有依据，比如 Ragas 的 faithfulness。它给的是事后的分数，裁判本身也会两头出错。在机器人里，用第二个模型核对句子，有的多出来的步骤没拦住，有的对的句子反而被删了。字符串比对每次结果都一样，也没法被说服。

不联网，没有依赖。 整个包大约 290 行，只用标准库。四句摘句对五段 500 字的资料，核对一次大约 0.3 毫秒。

不管检索，提示词只给个起点。 quotegate.prompts 里有中英文两个系统提示词，要求模型按这个格式回答，但找对资料是调用方的事。README 里写清楚了它做不到的：一句真实但答非所问的话，照样能通过。

和机器人有关的东西都变成了 Rules 里的设置：长度、连接词的正则、判断过去年份用的当前年份，还有一个 checks 列表放你自己的规则。机器人按校区排序的那部分，完全没放进包里。

从打 tag 到 PyPI

我希望发版是件无聊的事：


  每次推送都在 Ubuntu、macOS、Windows 上，用 Python 3.10 和 3.13 跑测试，再跑 ruff。
  另一个任务构建 wheel，装进一个干净的虚拟环境，跑一遍 README 里的例子。这能抓住测试都过了、但打包时漏了文件的情况。
  推一个 v0.1.0 tag 会触发 release.yml。它先检查 tag 和 __version__ 一致、CHANGELOG.md 有这一节、打 tag 的提交在 main 上，然后再跑一遍测试，用 PyPI 的 Trusted Publishing 上传，哪里都不用存令牌。GitHub Release 的内容直接取自更新日志的那一节。


0.1.0 就是 10 月 26 日这样发出去的。

接下来

机器人里还留着自己那份核对代码，在 wxbot/rag.py。下一步是让它改用这个包，两边就不会越改越不一样。

小结


  输入输出清楚的代码才值得抽出来，懂你产品的那部分留在原地。
  写清楚这个包拦不住什么。对一个安全检查来说，这比功能列表更重要。
  发版的检查放进发版流程里：版本号、更新日志、分支，最后从干净环境装一遍。


代码：core.py、test.yml、release.yml。PyPI：pypi.org/project/quotegate。

title: One question, two campuses
description: Visas, insurance, intermission and closing units follow different rules at Monash's Australian and Malaysian campuses. How Monash Hub answers both side by side, and the test that fails an answer that forgets which country it is about.
content:
Many readers of Monash Hub study at the Malaysia campus, or are parents of students there. Most of Monash’s own pages are written for the Australian campuses. When a question depends on a country’s law or a campus’s timetable, a right answer for one campus can be a wrong answer for the other.

This post covers how the site and the WeChat bot now answer those questions, from the pull requests of 25 October.

The answer that was wrong for half the readers

The curated answer to “Can I take a semester off?” told every student on a student visa that intermission changes their CoE. A Confirmation of Enrolment is part of the Australian student visa. In Malaysia the Student Pass rules apply, and they are different: intermission for medical reasons can keep the pass, any other reason cancels it, and coming back needs a new eVAL 4 to 2 months before the semester.

Nothing in the answer was false for Australia. It was just not labelled, so a Malaysia student read it as their rule.

Two parts, two sources

Answers that depend on a country now have an Australia part and a Malaysia part, each written from that campus’s official page (#219). The FAQ entry lists the Malaysia pages next to the Australian one, so both are cited:

FaqSeed(
    "apply-for-intermission",
    "Can I take a semester off?",
    "Yes - it is called intermission, and approval is not automatic. The rules for "
    "international students depend on the campus. "
    "Australia: you can take up to 12 months ... a new Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) ... "
    "Malaysia: you can take up to two semesters or 12 months ... "
    "you must cancel your Student Pass and leave Malaysia ...",
    ...
    malaysia_pages=("malaysia-changing-your-enrolment-intermission",
                    "malaysia-international-students-during-your-studies"),
)


The same split went into withdrawing from a unit, work hours, census dates, health insurance (OSHC in Australia, the insurance Monash Malaysia buys with the Student Pass), underload and overload. The Malaysia underload part comes from the notes on the SORS form itself: the form, the Friday of Week 2 deadline, and talking to the International Student Pass Office first.

While checking these against the pages, one more answer turned out wrong for everyone: it said a fail is worth 0 in the GPA. On Monash’s scale it is 0.3. The answer now gives the whole scale and Malaysia’s CGPA values.

A test for the label

Splitting answers by hand only works until the next answer is added. So a test reads every FAQ entry and fails when an answer names a rule of one country without naming the country, in English or in the Chinese translation:

AUSTRALIA_ONLY = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:CoE|OSHC|ESOS|Centrelink|HECS|HELP|Home Affairs|student visa)\b")
MALAYSIA_ONLY = re.compile(r"\b(?:Student Pass|EMGS|eVAL|MOHE|WD-LATE|CGPA)\b")

def test_a_rule_of_one_country_says_which_country(seed):
    zh = "".join(FAQ_ZH.get(seed.slug, ()))
    text = seed.question + " " + seed.answer
    if AUSTRALIA_ONLY.search(seed.answer):
        assert "Australia" in text, seed.slug
        assert not zh or "澳大利亚" in zh, seed.slug
    if MALAYSIA_ONLY.search(seed.answer):
        assert "Malaysia" in text, seed.slug
        assert not zh or "马来西亚" in zh, seed.slug


A second test checks that every Malaysia page an answer cites exists and is marked as a Malaysia page.

Closing units close on different dates

The Faculty of IT is revising its degrees, and each campus publishes its own teach-out table: which units close and what replaces them. The two tables do not agree. FIT3161 is gone in Australia and runs to S2 2027 in Malaysia. FIT1043 runs once more in Malaysia, with its final offering in S1 2027.

Searching a closed unit used to say only that the Handbook has no such unit. Now it says which Handbook last had it and shows the teach-out notice for both campuses, the reader’s campus first, each with a link to its faculty page (#225).

Two rules keep this honest:


  The notice is the faculty’s own table, shown word for word. The site never works out a replacement itself.
  Neither campus’s list fills a gap in the other. When a campus’s table leaves a unit out, the page says so, because “not listed” is not the same as “safe”.


The bot does the same

The WeChat bot answers from the same FAQ, plus Q&As I taught it and the account’s articles. Its taught answers for visas, insurance and study load now give 【马来西亚校区】 and 【澳洲校区】 separately. When the model is asked, it may only quote, and a quote from an Australian page, or one with CoE, OSHC or similar in it, goes last under its own heading. I wrote about that part in A Q&A bot where the model is only allowed to quote.

Takeaways


  When two sources disagree because they describe different places, show both and label them. Do not merge them.
  A word list is enough to catch most unlabelled rules. CoE, OSHC and Student Pass each belong to one country.
  “We have no notice for this unit” and “this unit is fine” are different answers. Say the first one.

title: 一个问题，两个校区
description: 签证、保险、休学和课程停开，Monash 澳洲校区和马来西亚校区规定不一样。Monash Hub 怎么把两边并排答出来，以及一个测试怎么拦住忘了写国家的回答。
content:
Monash Hub 的读者里有不少是马来西亚校区的同学和家长，但 Monash 自己的页面大多是写给澳洲校区的。问题一旦和国家的法规或者校区的安排有关，对一个校区是对的答案，对另一个校区可能就是错的。

这篇讲网站和微信问答机器人现在怎么回答这类问题，内容来自 10 月 25 日的几个 PR。

对一半读者是错的答案

“可以休学一个学期吗”这条整理好的回答，以前告诉所有持学生签证的同学：休学会改变你的 CoE。CoE（Confirmation of Enrolment）是澳洲学生签证的东西。马来西亚校区看的是 Student Pass 的规定，而且不一样：因为生病休学可以保留 Student Pass，其他原因要注销，回来时要在开学前 4 到 2 个月重新申请 eVAL。

这段话对澳洲来说没有错，只是没写是哪国的，马来西亚校区的同学就会当成自己的规定。

分两段写，各有出处

和国家有关的回答，现在分成澳大利亚和马来西亚两段，每段按那个校区的官方页面写（#219）。FAQ 条目在澳洲页面旁边列出马来西亚的页面，两边都会引用：

FaqSeed(
    "apply-for-intermission",
    "Can I take a semester off?",
    "Yes - it is called intermission, and approval is not automatic. The rules for "
    "international students depend on the campus. "
    "Australia: you can take up to 12 months ... a new Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE) ... "
    "Malaysia: you can take up to two semesters or 12 months ... "
    "you must cancel your Student Pass and leave Malaysia ...",
    ...
    malaysia_pages=("malaysia-changing-your-enrolment-intermission",
                    "malaysia-international-students-during-your-studies"),
)


退课、打工时长、census date、医疗保险（澳洲是 OSHC，马来西亚校区是学校随 Student Pass 一起买的保险）、减课和多修课，都按同样的方式拆开写。马来西亚的减课部分来自 SORS 表格自己的说明：用哪张表、第 2 周周五截止、提交前先联系 International Student Pass Office。

对照官网核对的时候，还发现一条对所有人都错的回答：它说挂科在 GPA 里算 0 分。按 Monash 的标准是 0.3。现在这条回答列出整个分数表，还有马来西亚校区的 CGPA。

用测试检查有没有标国家

手动拆分只能管住现有的回答，下一条新回答可能又忘了。所以加了一个测试，读每一条 FAQ：回答里提到只属于某个国家的规定，却没写是哪个国家，英文和中文翻译任何一边漏了，测试就失败：

AUSTRALIA_ONLY = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:CoE|OSHC|ESOS|Centrelink|HECS|HELP|Home Affairs|student visa)\b")
MALAYSIA_ONLY = re.compile(r"\b(?:Student Pass|EMGS|eVAL|MOHE|WD-LATE|CGPA)\b")

def test_a_rule_of_one_country_says_which_country(seed):
    zh = "".join(FAQ_ZH.get(seed.slug, ()))
    text = seed.question + " " + seed.answer
    if AUSTRALIA_ONLY.search(seed.answer):
        assert "Australia" in text, seed.slug
        assert not zh or "澳大利亚" in zh, seed.slug
    if MALAYSIA_ONLY.search(seed.answer):
        assert "Malaysia" in text, seed.slug
        assert not zh or "马来西亚" in zh, seed.slug


另一个测试检查回答引用的马来西亚页面确实存在，而且标的是马来西亚校区。

课程停开，两个校区日期不同

IT 学院在改学位结构，两个校区各自发布一张 teach-out 表：哪些课停开，用什么课替换。这两张表对不上。FIT3161 在澳洲已经停了，在马来西亚开到 2027 年 S2。FIT1043 在马来西亚还开最后一次，是 2027 年 S1。

以前搜一门停开的课，只会说 Handbook 里没有这门课。现在会说最后一次出现在哪一年的 Handbook，并且把两个校区的停开通知都列出来，读者所在的校区在前，各自附上学院页面的链接（#225）。

有两条规则：


  通知就是学院自己的表格，原样显示。网站自己从来不推算替换课程。
  一个校区的表不拿来补另一个校区的空。某个校区的表里没有这门课，页面就照实说没有，因为“没列出来”不等于“没问题”。


机器人也一样

微信机器人用的是同一套 FAQ，再加上我教它的问答和公众号文章。签证、保险、修课量这些教过的问答，现在分【马来西亚校区】和【澳洲校区】两段写。需要问大模型的时候，模型只能摘原句；来自澳洲页面的句子，或者带 CoE、OSHC 这类词的句子，放在最后，单独加标题。这部分我在《只许大模型摘原句的问答机器人》里写过。

小结


  两个来源说的不一样，是因为它们讲的是不同的地方，那就两边都列出来、标清楚，不要合成一句。
  一张词表就能抓住大部分没标国家的规定。CoE、OSHC、Student Pass 各自只属于一个国家。
  “我们没有这门课的通知”和“这门课没问题”是两个答案。要说的是前一个。

title: A plan code the server never sees, and searches counted without people
description: Monash Hub has no accounts for course plans. How a plan moves to another device in a link the server never receives, how the home page shows real searches while storing only a word, a day and a count, and a privacy note that had to be corrected.
content:
Monash Hub lets students plan their degree semester by semester without signing in. The plan lives in the browser’s localStorage. That keeps the server out of it, but it also means the plan stays on one device.

Two changes this week ran into the same question: how much does the server need to know? This post covers both, and one place where the site said less than the truth.

Moving a plan without an account

Export already wrote a JSON file. On a laptop that is fine. On a phone the file lands in Downloads and has to be sent on and opened, which most people will not do.

A line of text is easier. It goes through any chat app, including WeChat’s file transfer chat with yourself. So “Copy plan code” in the course map’s More menu now writes the plan as one readable line (#235):

MH1|<name>|<start year>|<years>|<campus>|<degree>|<periods>|<entries>

MH1|My%20plan|2026|3|Malaysia|C2001|S1;S2|FIT1008@0.0,FIT2004@1.1


Periods are short codes. Each entry is CODE@year.period, with the year counted from the start year and the period as an index into the list. Text fields are URI-encoded, so the | only ever separates fields. I kept it readable instead of compressing it, so a student can see what it says and chat apps do not mangle it with link detection.

The button copies a link with the code after the #:

function planLink(): string {
  return `${window.location.origin}/plan#plan=${encodeURIComponent(encodePlan(plan.value))}`
}


A browser never sends the part after # to the server. The page reads it, opens the plan as a new plan, and removes the code from the address bar so a reload does not import it twice:

function readHash() {
  const hash = window.location.hash
  if (!hash.includes('plan=')) return
  const code = findPlanCode(hash)
  if (code) importCode(code)
  history.replaceState(history.state, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search)
}


findPlanCode accepts a bare code, a whole link, or a message with a code somewhere inside it, because people paste whatever their chat app gives them. The decoded plan goes through the same sanitise function as an imported file, so a hand-edited code cannot put nonsense into storage.

What this does not do: anyone with the link can open the plan. That is the point of a link, and the plan holds unit codes, not grades or names, unless the student types a name into the plan’s title.

The privacy note was wrong

While working on the course map I reread the note under it. It said the plan is “not uploaded”. That was not true. Checking a plan sends the unit codes, teaching periods and campus to /v1/plan/check, which works out prerequisites and problems.

The note now says exactly that, and that the server does not keep them (#231). “Saved in this browser only” also moved next to the plan name, so nobody mistakes the plan for something saved to an account.

The home page’s “popular searches” were made up

Under the home search box there was a row of six searches labelled “Often searched” (热门搜索 in Chinese). They were a fixed list in the code. The site did not log searches at all. In #227 I relabelled them as examples: Try, 试试搜, 検索例, 검색 예시.

Then I made the real version (#237). The question was how to count searches without keeping anything about the people who make them.

A word, a day and a count

Each row in the new search_terms table holds a term, a day and a count. No IP, no account, no time of day. A search is counted once, and only when it found something:

def normalise(query):
    term = " ".join(query.split())
    if not 2 <= len(term) <= 60 or len(term.split()) > 4:
        return None          # sentences are not search terms
    if "@" in term or "://" in term or LONG_NUMBER.search(term):
        return None          # an email, a link, a phone or student number
    return term


An email address, a pasted link or a run of six or more digits is never stored, whatever it found.

One person should not be able to put words on the home page

The site is small. Without limits, one person searching the same word thirty times would put it on the front page for everyone. So the list the home page reads has two guards:

capped = func.sum(func.least(SearchTerm.hits, DAILY_CAP))   # at most 20 a day
rows = db.execute(
    select(SearchTerm.term, func.max(SearchTerm.label), capped.label("hits"))
    .where(SearchTerm.day >= since)                            # the last 14 days
    .group_by(SearchTerm.term)
    .having(func.count(func.distinct(SearchTerm.day)) >= 2)   # on two different days
    .order_by(capped.desc(), SearchTerm.term)
    .limit(limit)
).all()


A day adds at most 20 to a term, and a term has to have been searched on two different days. Rows older than 60 days are deleted. Until at least three terms pass, the home page shows the six examples again, labelled as examples.

These guards raise the cost. They do not make it impossible: someone who searches the same real term on two days can still get it listed. Since a term only counts when it finds something on the site, the worst case is a real unit code or topic showing up that not many people searched.

Takeaways


  The part of a URL after # is a free way to pass data between two copies of your own page without the server.
  Read your privacy notes again after each feature. Mine was true when written and wrong a few features later.
  Before showing “popular” anything, decide what one person can do to it. Caps per day and a minimum number of days are cheap.

title: 服务器看不到的规划码，和不记人的热门搜索
description: Monash Hub 的选课规划不用注册账号。规划怎么通过一个服务器收不到的链接搬到另一台设备，首页怎么显示真实的搜索词却只存词、日期和次数，以及一条要改正的隐私说明。
content:
Monash Hub 的选课规划不用登录，规划存在浏览器的 localStorage 里。这样服务器碰不到规划，但规划也就只能留在一台设备上。

这周有两个改动碰到同一个问题：服务器到底需要知道多少？这篇讲这两个改动，还有一处网站说得不够实在的地方。

不用账号，把规划搬到另一台设备

原来已经有导出 JSON 文件的功能。电脑上没问题，手机上文件会进下载文件夹，还要发出去再打开，大部分人不会这么做。

一行文字就方便多了，任何聊天软件都能发，包括微信的“文件传输助手”。所以课程地图“更多”菜单里新加了“复制规划码”，把规划写成一行能看懂的文字（#235）：

MH1|<名称>|<入学年份>|<年数>|<校区>|<专业>|<学期>|<课程>

MH1|My%20plan|2026|3|Malaysia|C2001|S1;S2|FIT1008@0.0,FIT2004@1.1


学期用简写。每门课写成 代码@第几年.第几个学期，年份从入学那年算起，学期是在学期列表里的位置。文字字段做了 URI 编码，所以 | 只会是分隔符。我没有压缩它，这样同学能看出里面写了什么，聊天软件识别链接时也不会把它弄乱。

按钮复制的是一个链接，规划码放在 # 后面：

function planLink(): string {
  return `${window.location.origin}/plan#plan=${encodeURIComponent(encodePlan(plan.value))}`
}


浏览器从来不会把 # 后面的部分发给服务器。页面自己读出来，作为一个新规划打开，再把规划码从地址栏去掉，免得刷新时又导入一次：

function readHash() {
  const hash = window.location.hash
  if (!hash.includes('plan=')) return
  const code = findPlanCode(hash)
  if (code) importCode(code)
  history.replaceState(history.state, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search)
}


findPlanCode 接受单独的规划码、整个链接，或者中间夹着规划码的一段消息，因为大家会把聊天软件给的东西整段粘进来。解出来的规划和导入文件走同一个 sanitise 函数，手动改坏的规划码也写不进奇怪的数据。

它做不到的：拿到链接的人都能打开这个规划。链接本来就是干这个的。规划里只有课程代码，没有成绩，也没有名字，除非同学自己把名字写进规划标题。

隐私说明写错了

改课程地图的时候，我重新读了下面那行说明。它写的是规划“不会上传”。这不对。检查规划时，课程代码、学期和校区会发给 /v1/plan/check，由它算先修课和冲突。

现在说明照实写了这一点，并说明服务器不保存这些内容（#231）。“只保存在这个浏览器”也挪到了规划名字旁边，免得有人以为规划存进了账号。

首页的“热门搜索”是编的

首页搜索框下面原来有一排六个词，标着“热门搜索”（英文是 Often searched）。其实是代码里写死的，网站根本不记录搜索。在 #227 里我先把它们改成“试试搜”，标明是例子。

然后才做了真正的版本（#237）。问题是：怎么统计搜索，又不留下任何关于搜索的人的信息。

只存一个词、一个日期和一个次数

新的 search_terms 表里，每一行只有搜索词、日期和次数。没有 IP，没有账号，也没有具体时间。一次搜索只算一次，而且只有搜到了东西才算：

def normalise(query):
    term = " ".join(query.split())
    if not 2 <= len(term) <= 60 or len(term.split()) > 4:
        return None          # 一整句话不算搜索词
    if "@" in term or "://" in term or LONG_NUMBER.search(term):
        return None          # 邮箱、链接、电话或学号
    return term


邮箱、粘贴的链接，或者连着六位以上的数字，不管搜到什么都不存。

一个人不应该能决定首页显示什么

网站不大。如果不加限制，一个人把同一个词搜三十遍，它就会出现在所有人的首页上。所以首页读的列表有两道限制：

capped = func.sum(func.least(SearchTerm.hits, DAILY_CAP))   # 每天最多算 20 次
rows = db.execute(
    select(SearchTerm.term, func.max(SearchTerm.label), capped.label("hits"))
    .where(SearchTerm.day >= since)                            # 最近 14 天
    .group_by(SearchTerm.term)
    .having(func.count(func.distinct(SearchTerm.day)) >= 2)   # 至少两天有人搜
    .order_by(capped.desc(), SearchTerm.term)
    .limit(limit)
).all()


一个词一天最多加 20 次，而且要在两个不同的日子被搜过。超过 60 天的记录会删掉。符合条件的词不到三个时，首页还是显示那六个例子，并标明是例子。

这两道限制只是提高了成本，不是做不到：有人连着两天搜同一个真实的词，还是能让它上榜。不过只有在站内搜到东西的词才会被统计，所以最坏的情况是，一个真实的课程代码或话题上了榜，其实没多少人搜过。

小结


  网址 # 后面的部分，可以在你自己网站的两个页面之间传数据，不经过服务器。
  每加一个功能，都重新读一遍隐私说明。我的那句写的时候是对的，过了几个功能就不对了。
  要显示“热门”之前，先想清楚一个人能对它做什么。每天封顶、至少几天，这种限制成本很低。

title: An offline app that never shows an old page when a new one is there
description: Monash Hub can now be added to a phone's home screen and opens pages you have read with no signal. Why the service worker always tries the network first, what it refuses to save, and how an app left open for days picks up a new deploy.
content:
Students look things up on Monash Hub on the bus, in a lecture hall basement, or with mobile data off to save money. On 24 October I made it installable: it can go on a phone’s home screen with its own icon, open full screen like an app, and show pages you have already read when there is no signal (#207).

I did not build a native app. A web app manifest and one service worker cover iPhone Safari, Android browsers and desktop Chrome with the same code. The hard part was deciding what the service worker is allowed to do.

The one rule: never older than the server

A service worker can make a site feel faster by answering from a cache first. For Monash Hub that is the wrong trade. A unit page or an enrolment guide that is a week old can send a student to the wrong form. So the comment at the top of sw.js says what it is for:


  A student who added Monash Hub to their home screen can open the unit, degree and guide pages they have already read when there is no signal. That is all. It is not a way to make the site faster online, and it must never make a student read something older than what the server has.


Every page and API call goes to the network first. A saved copy is used only when the network cannot be reached at all:

async function networkFirst(event, cacheName) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(event.request)
    save(event, cacheName, response)
    return response
  } catch (error) {
    const saved = await caches.open(cacheName).then(cache => cache.match(event.request))
    if (saved) return saved
    throw error
  }
}


A 404 or a 500 from the server is passed through as it is. It is not a network failure, so it never falls back to an older copy. When a saved page is shown, the page says there is no network and the copy may be out of date.

What is never saved

Only reference pages are worth reading offline: the home page, units, degrees, guides, and the course map, tree and marks pages, which keep their own data in the browser anyway. Everything live or personal is left out on purpose:

/* The API calls those pages make. Reviews, community, auth and search are left out on purpose. */
const OFFLINE_API = [
  /^\/api\/v1\/units(\/|$)/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/courses(\/|$)/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/guides(\/|$)/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/(faq|key-dates)$/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/exchange$/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/marks\/(reference|units)$/
]


And only a complete, successful answer is kept:

function save(event, cacheName, response) {
  if (response.status !== 200 || response.type !== 'basic') return
  if ((response.headers.get('Cache-Control') || '').includes('no-store')) return
  ...
}


That rule needed one change in the pages. When the API failed, the unit, degree and guide list pages still rendered with status 200, showing an error card. The service worker would have saved that card over a good copy. They now answer 503, like the detail pages already did.

Two smaller details:


  A saved page is in the language it was rendered in. When the reader switches language, the saved pages are deleted. API answers carry the locale in their URL, so they stay.
  VERSION in the cache names is bumped whenever the caching rules change. The new worker deletes every cache the old one made, so nothing saved under old rules survives.


A page you never opened

Offline, a page that was never saved shows an offline page in the reader’s language, with links to the pages that are saved. Inside the app, following a link normally fetches data from the API, and only some of that is saved. So when the phone is offline, a link becomes a full page load, which the service worker can answer with the saved page or the offline page.

An app left open for days

Network first means a new deploy shows up on the next page load. The case left is an app that stays open on a phone for days. Nuxt reloads on the next navigation once it sees a new build, but it only checks once an hour, and phones pause timers while an app is in the background.

So the app also checks when it comes back to the front, at most every five minutes:

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForNewBuild()
})


checkForNewBuild asks the browser to update sw.js and compares the running build id with /_nuxt/builds/latest.json. If they differ, the next link loads the new version.

Telling people they can install it

Most students do not know a website can go on the home screen, and the steps differ by browser. On phones, after a few pages, a one-line hint explains how for iPhone Safari, Android browsers (including Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo) and WeChat. “Don’t show again” hides it for good, and the same steps are in the footer.

How it is tested

Playwright tests in CI cover the parts that are easy to break:


  the manifest returns the right name, description and shortcuts in Chinese and English, and every icon exists
  a unit page read once opens again with the network off and shows the “no network” notice, while ratings and community calls were never saved
  a page never opened gets the offline page, and “retry” works once the network is back
  a unit that was not found is not saved
  the install hint waits a few pages and stays closed once closed


Takeaways


  Decide what the service worker is for before writing it, and write that at the top of the file.
  Network first, cache only on a real network failure, and never cache an error.
  An installed app can stay open for days. Check for a new build when it comes back to the front.

title: 能离线用，但有新版本时绝不显示旧页面
description: Monash Hub 现在可以添加到手机主屏幕，没信号也能打开看过的页面。为什么 service worker 永远先走网络，哪些东西坚决不存，以及开着好几天的应用怎么拿到新版本。
content:
同学查 Monash Hub 的时候，可能在公交上、在地下的阶梯教室里，或者为了省流量关了数据。10 月 24 日我让它可以“安装”：能添加到手机主屏幕，有自己的图标，像应用一样全屏打开，没信号时也能打开已经看过的页面（#207）。

我没有做原生应用。一个 web app manifest 加一个 service worker，同一套代码就能覆盖 iPhone Safari、安卓浏览器和电脑上的 Chrome。难的是决定 service worker 能做什么、不能做什么。

只有一条规则：不能比服务器旧

service worker 可以先从缓存里拿内容，让网站看起来更快。对 Monash Hub 来说这不划算。一个旧了一周的课程页或选课指南，可能让同学填错表。所以 sw.js 开头的注释写明了它是干什么的：


  把 Monash Hub 加到主屏幕的同学，没信号时可以打开已经看过的课程、学位和指南页面。就这些。它不是用来让网站在有网时变快的，也绝不能让同学看到比服务器上更旧的内容。


每个页面和接口请求都先走网络。只有完全连不上网络时，才用存下来的副本：

async function networkFirst(event, cacheName) {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(event.request)
    save(event, cacheName, response)
    return response
  } catch (error) {
    const saved = await caches.open(cacheName).then(cache => cache.match(event.request))
    if (saved) return saved
    throw error
  }
}


服务器返回 404 或 500，照原样交给页面。这不算网络故障，所以不会退回旧副本。显示存下来的页面时，页面上会提示现在没有网络，内容可能不是最新的。

哪些东西坚决不存

值得离线看的只有资料类页面：首页、课程、学位、指南，还有课程地图、先修树和分数计算器，它们本来就把数据存在浏览器里。所有实时的、个人的东西都故意不存：

/* The API calls those pages make. Reviews, community, auth and search are left out on purpose. */
const OFFLINE_API = [
  /^\/api\/v1\/units(\/|$)/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/courses(\/|$)/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/guides(\/|$)/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/(faq|key-dates)$/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/exchange$/,
  /^\/api\/v1\/marks\/(reference|units)$/
]


而且只存完整、成功的响应：

function save(event, cacheName, response) {
  if (response.status !== 200 || response.type !== 'basic') return
  if ((response.headers.get('Cache-Control') || '').includes('no-store')) return
  ...
}


这条规则让页面那边也要改一处。接口出错时，课程、学位和指南的列表页面还是返回 200 状态，显示一张错误卡片。service worker 会把这张卡片存下来，盖掉原来好的副本。现在它们和详情页一样返回 503。

还有两个小细节：


  存下来的页面是当时的语言。读者切换语言时，存的页面全部删掉。接口的响应在网址里带着语言，可以留着。
  缓存名字里有 VERSION，缓存规则一改就加一。新的 worker 会删掉旧 worker 建的所有缓存，按旧规则存的东西一样都不留。


从没打开过的页面

离线时，打开一个从没存过的页面，会显示一个离线页，用读者的语言，列出已经存了哪些页面。在应用里点链接，平时是从接口拿数据，而接口的响应只存了一部分。所以手机离线时，点链接会改成整页加载，这样 service worker 就能返回存下来的页面或者离线页。

开着好几天的应用

先走网络，意味着下次加载页面就是新版本。剩下的情况是应用在手机上一开好几天。Nuxt 发现新版本后，下次跳转就会重新加载，但它一小时才检查一次，而手机会在应用退到后台时暂停计时器。

所以应用回到前台时也检查一次，最多五分钟一次：

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') checkForNewBuild()
})


checkForNewBuild 会让浏览器检查 sw.js 有没有更新，并且对比当前运行的版本号和 /_nuxt/builds/latest.json。不一样的话，下次点链接就加载新版本。

告诉大家可以安装

大部分同学不知道网站可以加到主屏幕，不同浏览器的步骤也不一样。在手机上看过几个页面后，会出现一行提示，说明 iPhone Safari、安卓浏览器（包括华为、小米、OPPO、vivo）和微信里怎么操作。点“不再显示”就永远不出现，页脚里也有同样的步骤。

怎么测试

CI 里的 Playwright 测试覆盖了容易坏的地方：


  manifest 的名字、介绍和快捷方式，中英文都对，每个图标都存在
  看过一次的课程页，断网后还能打开，并显示“现在没有网络”的提示，同时评分和社区的请求从来没被存过
  从没打开过的页面显示离线页，网络恢复后点“重试”能正常打开
  找不到的课程不会被存
  安装提示要看过几个页面才出现，关掉后不再出现


小结


  写 service worker 之前先想清楚它是干什么的，写在文件开头。
  先走网络，只有真正连不上才用缓存，出错的响应永远不存。
  装到主屏幕的应用可能一开好几天，回到前台时检查有没有新版本。

title: Getting a Chrome extension ready for the Web Store
description: Before putting my attendance extension on the Chrome Web Store, I removed a permission, deleted URLs from a library I never call, and made the build refuse to package remote code. What the store checks, and how I checked it myself first.
content:
Monash Attendance Helper is a Chrome extension for Monash students. It reads your recent classes from Monash Attendance, finds the codes teaching staff posted in Gmail, Moodle and Ed, and shows them on one page. Nothing is submitted until you tick that you attended and press submit.

Until now it was installed from a zip in developer mode, which is too much to ask of most students. So on 25 October I submitted v1.3.52 to the Chrome Web Store. It is still waiting for review. This post is about what I changed to get there.

Update, 30 October: it passed review and is now on the Chrome Web Store. The zip is still on GitHub for anyone who wants to load it unpacked.

Remote code that never runs still counts

Codes are often posted as screenshots, so the extension bundles Tesseract.js for OCR. It runs in an offscreen document, because a service worker has no DOM or canvas, and it loads its worker, WebAssembly core and English data from the package with chrome.runtime.getURL.

The store forbids remotely hosted code under Manifest V3, and its scan reads the files, not what the code does at runtime. The upstream Tesseract.js files still had jsDelivr URLs as fallbacks. My code always passed local paths, so those URLs were never used, but the scan treats them as remote code anyway.

v1.3.49 replaced the fallback URLs with the packaged files, and a test fails if any URL literal comes back in the bundled Tesseract files:

assert.doesNotMatch(source, /https?:\/\//i, `${asset} must not contain remote URL literals`);


Make the build refuse

One test for one library is not enough. The next library update, or a stray <script src> in a page, would bring the problem back. So the store zip is built by scripts/build-store-zip.sh, which unpacks what it just zipped and refuses to keep it if it finds:


  a CDN host (jsDelivr, unpkg, cdnjs, Google’s font and API hosts) anywhere in code, pages or JSON
  any http(s):// inside the bundled Tesseract files
  a <script> or <link> that loads from another origin
  a remote import, importScripts, eval or new Function in the extension’s own code
  a remote origin in the content security policy


if grep -rIEn 'import\(?\s*["'\''](https?:)?//|importScripts\(\s*["'\'']https?:|new Function\(|\beval\(' \
     "$tmp" --include='*.js' --exclude-dir=vendor; then
  flag "remote import or eval in extension code"
fi
...
if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi


CI runs it on every pull request, not only on main, so a change that would fail review fails before it is merged.

Drop the permission that scares people

The manifest asked for tabs. With it, Chrome warns on install that the extension can “read your browsing history”. That is a bad first impression for a tool that touches your Monash login.

The extension only needed tabs for two things: opening background tabs and reading the URL of its own Attendance, Moodle, Ed and Gmail tabs. chrome.tabs.create needs no permission at all. And host permissions already let an extension see the URL and title of tabs on those hosts.

I checked that in Chromium with the extension loaded before removing it. chrome.tabs.query still returned the URL of an open Ed thread and still hid other sites. v1.3.52 ships without tabs, and the warning is gone.

What is left, each with one sentence in the store form:


  
    
      Permission
      Why
    
  
  
    
      scripting
      Injects the page reader into a tab that was open before the extension was reloaded
    
    
      storage
      Settings, the latest scan and a diagnostic log, on the device
    
    
      alarms, notifications
      The weekly reminder and the “scan finished” notice
    
    
      offscreen
      Runs Tesseract, since a service worker has no canvas
    
    
      Six host permissions
      Attendance, Gmail, Moodle, Ed, Ed’s image host, and the CloudFront host Moodle serves uploaded files from
    
  


Check the privacy claim yourself

The listing says no server, no analytics and no remote code. I wanted to check it myself. So I ran OCR end to end with every request that did not go to the extension itself logged. It read “Workshop 02 GU2ZP” and “Tutorial 16 ST8CT” from a test image and made no network request.

Success has to mean success

One more fix went in before submitting, because strangers would now rely on it. In v1.3.50 and earlier, the page could say “已处理 2/2” while Attendance still showed a question mark for one class. “Success” only meant something had been clicked. Attendance is an ASP.NET page where the whole page is one form. The button search ran over every link in it, header and footer included, and took the first one with a word like “enter” in it.

Since v1.3.51 the search only takes real buttons and postback links, never home, back, cancel or logout. After the click, the extension reopens that day in Attendance in a fresh tab and only counts a class as done when its row shows completed. The confirm page lists each class with its own result and the reason when it failed.

Takeaways


  Store scans read files. A URL in code you never call is still a URL.
  Put the review rules in your build script, and run it on every pull request.
  Before asking for a permission, check whether a narrower API or a host permission already gives you what you need.

title: 把 Chrome 扩展准备好上架应用商店
description: 签到助手上架 Chrome 应用商店之前，我去掉了一个权限，删掉了一个库里从来不会用到的网址，还让打包脚本遇到远程代码就拒绝打包。商店查什么，以及我怎么先自己查一遍。
content:
Monash 签到助手是给 Monash 同学用的 Chrome 扩展。它从 Monash Attendance 读出你最近的课，在 Gmail、Moodle 和 Ed 里找教学人员发的签到码，集中在一个页面上给你看。只有你勾选“我参加了这些课”并点提交，才会提交。

之前只能下载 zip、打开开发者模式手动安装，对大部分同学来说太麻烦了。所以 10 月 25 日我把 v1.3.52 提交到了 Chrome 应用商店，现在还在等审核。这篇讲为了上架改了什么。

10 月 30 日更新：已经过审，现在可以直接从 Chrome 应用商店安装。GitHub 上的 zip 还在，想手动加载的同学照样能用。

永远不会运行的远程代码也算

签到码经常是截图，所以扩展里打包了 Tesseract.js 做 OCR。它跑在 offscreen 文档里，因为 service worker 没有 DOM 和 canvas；它的 worker、WebAssembly 核心和英文数据都通过 chrome.runtime.getURL 从扩展包里加载。

Manifest V3 下商店不允许远程托管的代码，而它的扫描看的是文件内容，不看代码运行时实际做了什么。上游的 Tesseract.js 文件里还留着 jsDelivr 的网址当备用。我的代码一直传本地路径，这些网址根本用不到，但扫描照样会把它们当成远程代码。

v1.3.49 把这些备用网址换成了包里的文件，并加了一个测试：打包的 Tesseract 文件里只要再出现网址，测试就失败：

assert.doesNotMatch(source, /https?:\/\//i, `${asset} must not contain remote URL literals`);


让打包脚本直接拒绝

只给一个库写一个测试不够。下次升级库，或者哪个页面里多了一个 <script src>，问题又回来了。所以商店用的 zip 由 scripts/build-store-zip.sh 生成，它把刚打好的包解开检查，发现下面这些就不留这个包：


  代码、页面或 JSON 里出现 CDN 域名（jsDelivr、unpkg、cdnjs、Google 的字体和 API 域名）
  打包的 Tesseract 文件里有任何 http(s)://
  页面里有从别的域名加载的 <script> 或 <link>
  扩展自己的代码里有远程 import、importScripts、eval 或 new Function
  内容安全策略里允许了远程域名


if grep -rIEn 'import\(?\s*["'\''](https?:)?//|importScripts\(\s*["'\'']https?:|new Function\(|\beval\(' \
     "$tmp" --include='*.js' --exclude-dir=vendor; then
  flag "remote import or eval in extension code"
fi
...
if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then
  rm -f "$out"
  exit 1
fi


CI 在每个 PR 上都跑它，不只是 main，所以审核会被拒的改动，在合并之前就会失败。

去掉让人害怕的权限

原来 manifest 里申请了 tabs。有这个权限，安装时 Chrome 会提示扩展能“读取你的浏览记录”。对一个要用到你 Monash 登录状态的工具来说，这个第一印象很差。

扩展要 tabs 只是为了两件事：在后台打开标签页，以及读它自己打开的 Attendance、Moodle、Ed 和 Gmail 标签页的网址。chrome.tabs.create 本来就不需要任何权限。而有了这几个网站的权限，扩展本来就能看到这些网站标签页的网址和标题。

去掉之前，我在 Chromium 里装上扩展核对过：chrome.tabs.query 照样能拿到打开着的 Ed 帖子网址，其他网站仍然看不到。v1.3.52 不再申请 tabs，安装提示也没了。

剩下的权限，在商店表单里每个都用一句话说明：


  
    
      权限
      用途
    
  
  
    
      scripting
      扩展重新加载后，给之前已经打开的标签页注入读取脚本
    
    
      storage
      设置、最近一次扫描结果和诊断日志，存在本机
    
    
      alarms、notifications
      每周提醒和“扫描完成”通知
    
    
      offscreen
      运行 Tesseract，因为 service worker 没有 canvas
    
    
      六个网站权限
      Attendance、Gmail、Moodle、Ed、Ed 的图片域名，以及 Moodle 存上传文件用的 CloudFront 域名
    
  


隐私说法自己验证

商店介绍里写着没有服务器、没有统计、没有远程代码。我想自己核对一遍。所以我把 OCR 从头到尾跑了一遍，把所有不是发给扩展自己的请求都记下来。它从测试图片里读出了 “Workshop 02 GU2ZP” 和 “Tutorial 16 ST8CT”，没有发出任何网络请求。

“成功”必须是真的成功

提交之前还修了一个问题，因为以后会有不认识的人依赖它。v1.3.50 及以前，页面可能显示“已处理 2/2”，Attendance 里却还有一门课是问号。原来的“成功”只表示点到了某个东西。Attendance 是 ASP.NET 页面，整页就是一个表单；找按钮时把页头页脚的链接都算进去了，取的是第一个文字里有 “enter” 这类词的链接。

从 v1.3.51 开始，只找真正的按钮和回发链接，不会点首页、返回、取消或退出。点完之后，扩展会在新标签页重新打开 Attendance 的那一天，只有那一行显示已完成才算签上。确认页会列出每门课各自的结果，失败的写明原因。

小结


  商店的扫描看的是文件。你从来不调用的代码里有网址，也还是网址。
  把审核规则写进打包脚本，每个 PR 都跑。
  申请权限之前，先看看更窄的 API 或者网站权限是不是已经够用。


代码：build-store-zip.sh、manifest.json、store/LISTING.md、CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md。安装指南：docs.secureview.tech/zh-cn/attendance。

title: Refreshing an Ed forum in the browser without fetching it all again
description: Ed Web reads a course's Ed forum in the browser with no backend. The redesign added a refresh that only fetches posts that changed, an honest meaning for "new", Ed's post format rendered safely, and support for Ed's API tokens.
content:
Ed Web is a static page that fetches a unit’s Ed Discussion forum straight from Ed’s API, stores it in the browser’s IndexedDB, and lets you read, filter and search it offline. There is no backend: the token stays in sessionStorage and is only sent to edstem.org.

It is the public version of a private tool I run on my own server for my study workflow. On 25 October I redesigned Ed Web and brought over the parts of the private tool that work in a browser (#6). This post is about those parts.

Refresh only what changed

The old page fetched every thread and every reply on each refresh. A big unit has hundreds of threads, and Ed rate-limits, so a refresh took a while and sometimes hit 429.

Ed’s thread list is cheap, one request per 100 threads. Fetching a thread’s replies is one request per thread. So the refresh now reads the list, works out a fingerprint for each thread, and only fetches the full thread when its fingerprint changed:

/* Same as the private tool's content_stamp: updated_at plus a few counts and flags,
 * so a thread's body is fetched again only when something in it really changed. */
function contentStamp(t) {
  return [t.updated_at, t.reply_count, t.unresolved_count, t.vote_count, t.is_staff_answered,
          t.is_answered, t.is_locked, t.title].map((x) => String(x ?? '')).join('|');
}


updated_at alone is not enough. A new reply or a staff answer does not always move it, but it does change a count or a flag.

When Ed does answer 429, the page waits for Retry-After if the browser can read it, and otherwise backs off 1.5, 3 and 4.5 seconds.

What “new” means

A “new” badge is only useful if it means “new since I last looked”. Each thread and reply now stores first_seen, the time this browser first saw it. A refresh records when it started, and anything first seen at or after that moment is new:

function isFresh(firstSeen) {
  return !!STATE.prevSyncedAt && !!firstSeen && firstSeen >= STATE.syncedAt;
}


The first fetch has nothing to compare with, so it falls back to “posted in the last 48 hours”. A thread you already had shows how many replies are new.

Render Ed’s format, safely

Ed stores a post as its own XML: <document><paragraph>..., with <link>, <snippet>, <image>, <file>, lists, tables and callouts. The old page stripped it to plain text, so code lost its layout and attachments were gone.

docToHTML now parses it with DOMParser and walks the tree. Two rules keep it safe:


  Every piece of text goes through esc before it is written into the page. No markup from the post is passed through.
  Links, images, files and videos are only linked when the address starts with http:// or https://. Anything else, such as javascript:, becomes plain text.


const safeHref = (u) => (/^https?:\/\//i.test(String(u || '').trim()) ? String(u).trim() : null);


If the XML does not parse, the post falls back to plain text instead of a blank card.

A one-line takeaway from the right person

Each thread card shows one line under the title. It used to be the start of the post. For a question, the useful line is usually the answer, so the card now takes the last staff reply, because a later staff reply often corrects an earlier one. With no staff reply, a question shows a student’s answer, labelled as such. Otherwise it shows the post itself.

API tokens

Ed has two kinds of token. The one the web app keeps in localStorage is a JWT that expires after 14 days. The ones you create under Ed’s settings are long-lived and can be revoked there. They use different headers:

function authHeaders(token) {
  return tokenKind(token) === 'jwt' ? { 'x-token': token } : { authorization: 'Bearer ' + token };
}


The page shows how many days a JWT has left, read from its exp field. An API token has no expiry, so it suits a page you come back to every week. This is the same token handling as the private tool, where I use an API token myself.

Smaller things


  Search needs every word to appear.
  Filters for starred, watched and my own threads, and for threads with replies Ed says you have not read.
  Replies under a deleted reply are kept, since Ed still shows them.
  Lessons save the text of reading pages and quiz questions, so they can be searched too.


Testing a page with no backend

The fetch and render logic lives in one app.js with no build step. The tests in tests/sync.test.mjs cut the functions they need out of app.js by marker strings and run them in Node, with no network. The screenshots in the README were taken against a fake Ed API with made-up units, people and posts, so no real course data is in the repository.

Takeaways


  A cheap list plus a fingerprint per item turns a full refresh into a small one.
  “New” should be measured from the last refresh, not from the post date.
  When rendering someone else’s markup, escape all text and allow only the link schemes you mean.

title: 在浏览器里刷新 Ed 论坛，不用每次全部重抓
description: Ed Web 在浏览器里读 Ed 论坛，没有后端。这次改版加了只抓变化帖子的增量刷新、说得清楚的“新”标记、安全地渲染 Ed 的正文格式，还支持了 Ed 的 API 令牌。
content:
Ed Web 是一个静态网页：直接从 Ed 的接口抓一门课的 Ed Discussion 论坛，存进浏览器的 IndexedDB，离线也能看、筛选和搜索。没有后端，token 存在 sessionStorage 里，只发给 edstem.org。

它是我自己服务器上一个私人学习工具的公开版。10 月 25 日我给 Ed Web 改了版，把私人工具里能在浏览器里做的部分搬了过来（#6）。这篇讲这几部分。

只刷新变了的帖子

旧版每次刷新都把所有帖子和回复重抓一遍。大的课有几百个帖子，Ed 又限流，刷新要等很久，有时还会遇到 429。

Ed 的帖子列表很便宜，100 个帖子一个请求。抓一个帖子的回复则是一个帖子一个请求。所以现在刷新先读列表，给每个帖子算一个指纹，只有指纹变了才重抓整个帖子：

/* 跟私人工具的 content_stamp 一样：updated_at 之外再带几个计数和状态位，
 * 这样只有内容真变了才重抓正文。 */
function contentStamp(t) {
  return [t.updated_at, t.reply_count, t.unresolved_count, t.vote_count, t.is_staff_answered,
          t.is_answered, t.is_locked, t.title].map((x) => String(x ?? '')).join('|');
}


只看 updated_at 不够。新回复或者老师回答不一定会改它，但一定会改某个计数或状态位。

Ed 真的返回 429 时，浏览器能读到 Retry-After 就按它等，读不到就依次等 1.5、3、4.5 秒。

“新”是什么意思

“新”标记只有在表示“上次看过之后才出现的”时才有用。现在每个帖子和回复都存一个 first_seen，也就是这个浏览器第一次见到它的时间。每次刷新记下开始的时刻，在那之后第一次见到的就是新的：

function isFresh(firstSeen) {
  return !!STATE.prevSyncedAt && !!firstSeen && firstSeen >= STATE.syncedAt;
}


第一次抓的时候没有可比的，就退回“48 小时内发的”。以前就有的帖子，显示有几条新回复。

安全地渲染 Ed 的正文

Ed 用自己的 XML 存帖子：<document><paragraph>...，里面有 <link>、<snippet>、<image>、<file>、列表、表格和提示框。旧版把它全部转成纯文本，代码的格式乱了，附件也没了。

现在 docToHTML 用 DOMParser 解析，再遍历整棵树。有两条规则保证安全：


  每一段文字写进页面之前都经过 esc，帖子里的任何标签都不会原样输出。
  链接、图片、附件和视频，只有地址以 http:// 或 https:// 开头才做成链接。其他的，比如 javascript:，只显示成文字。


const safeHref = (u) => (/^https?:\/\//i.test(String(u || '').trim()) ? String(u).trim() : null);


XML 解析失败的话，退回纯文本，而不是显示一张空卡片。

一句话结论取对的人

每张帖子卡片在标题下显示一句话，以前是帖子的开头。对提问帖来说，有用的通常是回答，所以现在取最后一条老师的回复，因为后面的老师回复经常会更正前面的。没有老师回复的提问帖，显示同学的回答，并标明是同学答的。其他帖子显示帖子本身。

API 令牌

Ed 有两种 token。网页版存在 localStorage 里的是 JWT，14 天过期。在 Ed 设置里生成的 API 令牌不会过期，可以在那里撤销。两种用的请求头不一样：

function authHeaders(token) {
  return tokenKind(token) === 'jwt' ? { 'x-token': token } : { authorization: 'Bearer ' + token };
}


页面会从 JWT 的 exp 字段读出还剩几天。API 令牌不会过期，适合每周都要打开的页面。这和私人工具里的处理一样，我自己用的就是 API 令牌。

其他小改动


  搜索要求每个词都出现，不是只要有一个。
  可以按收藏、关注、我发的筛选，也可以筛出 Ed 记录里你还没看过回复的帖子。
  被删回复下面的子回复保留，因为 Ed 网页上也还显示。
  课程内容会存阅读页的正文和测验题，也能搜索。


没有后端的页面怎么测

抓取和渲染的逻辑都在一个 app.js 里，没有构建步骤。tests/sync.test.mjs 按标记字符串把需要的函数从 app.js 里切出来，在 Node 里执行，不连网。README 里的截图是对着一个假的 Ed 接口拍的，课程、人和帖子都是编的，仓库里没有任何真实的课程数据。

小结


  一个便宜的列表，加上每一项的指纹，就能把全量刷新变成小刷新。
  “新”应该从上次刷新算起，而不是从发帖时间算。
  渲染别人写的标记时，所有文字都转义，只放行你想要的链接协议。


代码：app.js、ARCHITECTURE.zh-CN.md、sync.test.mjs。使用指南：docs.secureview.tech/zh-cn/ed-web。

title: Which source wins when an AI reads your assignment
description: Monash Study Kit lets an AI read your own Moodle and Ed. When you ask it what an assignment wants, it now follows a fixed order of sources: the brief and rubric, then staff answers on Ed, with dates and a source for every rule. How that rule is written, and the test that keeps the agent instructions true.
content:
Monash Study Kit keeps a local copy of a student’s own Moodle and Ed Discussion and lets Claude, or another MCP client, answer questions from it: what is due this week, where a topic is covered, what changed on Ed. It is read-only. It cannot submit work, answer quizzes or post.

A common question is “what does assignment 2 actually want?”. Version 1.3.0, released this weekend, changes how that question is answered (#17).

The problem: Ed is full of guesses

For one assignment there can be a brief on Moodle, a marking rubric, and dozens of Ed threads. In those threads most replies are from other students. Some are right, some are guesses, and some were right until staff posted a correction two weeks later.

A model given all of that can blend it. A confident student reply, such as “I think you’re allowed to use lodash”, reads the same as a tutor’s. An old line in the brief and a newer staff correction can both end up in the answer as if they agreed.

The order of sources

The rule is short:


  The brief and the marking rubric come first. Find them and read the original text.
  Ed adds to the brief. Count only replies from teaching staff and answers they endorsed. Other students’ replies are leads, not rules.
  A later staff correction wins. But when the brief and Ed disagree, list both with their dates, say which is newer, and suggest the student confirm with staff. Do not decide for them.
  Give a source for every rule: file name and page, or post number, who said it and the date. If there is no source, say so. Do not fill the gap.


Point 3 does not let the model pick a winner when the brief and Ed disagree. It shows both with dates, and the student asks staff.

The rule only works because the data supports it. Study Kit’s Ed output already marks each reply as 教师 or 助教 when it is from staff, puts ✅ on endorsed answers, and shows every reply’s date. Without those marks, “only count staff replies” would be a hope, not an instruction.

Three places, one rule

Students use Study Kit in different ways, so the rule is in three places:


  The MCP server instructions. Clients read these when they connect, so the rule applies without the student doing anything.
  A preset prompt. “作业要求” in the client’s “+” menu takes an assignment name, reads the brief, the rubric and staff answers on Ed, and lists what to hand in, how it is marked, deadlines and format, and Ed clarifications, each with its source.
  An agent skill. skills/monash-study-kit/SKILL.md is for coding agents that call the monash CLI instead of MCP. It maps questions to commands, carries the same rule, and lists what only the student does: logging in, submitting, quizzes and posting. It installs with npx skills add Waldo0926/monash-study-kit.


The skill also says, in plain words: help the student understand the requirements. The work they hand in has to be their own, and unit rules on AI use apply.

A test that keeps the skill true

Instructions written for an agent rot quietly. If a command is renamed, the agent runs a command that does not exist and tells the student something failed. So a test reads SKILL.md and checks it against the real CLI:

TABLE = sorted(set(re.findall(r"^\|.*`(monash [^`]+)` \|$", TEXT, re.M)))

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cmd", TABLE)
def test_every_command_parses(cmd):
    with redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
        args = cli.build_parser().parse_args(shlex.split(cmd)[1:])
    assert getattr(args, "fn", None)

def test_exit_codes_match_cli():
    rows = dict(re.findall(r"^\| (\d+) \| (.+) \|$", TEXT, re.M))
    assert sorted(map(int, rows)) == sorted(cli.EXIT_CODES)

def test_assignment_rules_and_limits():
    assert "brief and the marking rubric come first" in TEXT
    assert "Other students' replies are leads" in TEXT
    assert "Never ask for, accept or repeat an Ed token" in TEXT


Every full command in the skill’s table must parse with the real argument parser. Every command mentioned in the text must exist. The exit code table must match EXIT_CODES. And the key sentences of the rule must still be there, so an edit cannot drop them by accident.

What this does not guarantee

This is an instruction to a model, not code that checks its answer. A model can still misread a rubric or miss a thread. What the rule changes is what the student gets back: sources and dates they can check in a minute, and a clear “ask staff” when the sources disagree.

Takeaways


  Tell the model which source wins before it sees the sources, and make it cite every rule.
  An instruction like “only trust staff” needs the data to carry who is staff.
  Test agent instructions against the real program, the same way you test docs examples.

title: AI 读作业要求时，该信哪个来源
description: Monash Study Kit 让 AI 读你自己的 Moodle 和 Ed。现在问它作业要求时，它按固定顺序看资料：先作业说明和评分细则，再看 Ed 上老师的回答，每条规定都标日期和出处。这条规则怎么写的，以及一个让给 AI 的说明书保持准确的测试。
content:
Monash Study Kit 在本地存一份同学自己的 Moodle 和 Ed Discussion，让 Claude 或其他 MCP 客户端从里面回答问题：这周要交什么、某个知识点在哪份资料里、Ed 上有什么新消息。它是只读的，不能交作业、做测验或发帖。

常见的一个问题是“作业 2 到底要我做什么”。这个周末发布的 1.3.0 版改了回答这类问题的方式（#17）。

问题：Ed 上全是猜测

一份作业，Moodle 上有作业说明，有评分细则，Ed 上还有几十个帖子。这些帖子里大部分回复是同学写的。有的对，有的是猜的，还有的本来是对的，直到两周后老师发了更正。

把这些全给模型，它可能会混在一起。一句很有把握的同学回复，比如“我觉得可以用 lodash”，读起来和助教说的一样。作业说明里的旧说法和老师后来的更正，也可能被当成一致的意思写进答案。

资料的顺序

规则很短：


  作业说明和评分细则优先。 先找到它们，读原文。
  Ed 是对作业说明的补充。 只认教师和助教的回复，以及他们 endorsed 的回答。同学的回复只当线索，不当规定。
  老师后来的更正优先。 但作业说明和 Ed 说法不一致时，两边都列出来，标上日期，说明哪个更新，建议同学找老师确认。不替同学做决定。
  每条规定都标出处：文件名和页码，或者帖子编号、谁说的、哪天说的。找不到出处就直说，不自己补。


第 3 条不让模型在作业说明和 Ed 不一致时选一边。它把两边都列出来、标上日期，由同学去问老师。

这条规则能用，是因为数据本身支持。Study Kit 输出 Ed 内容时，老师的回复本来就标着“教师”或“助教”，endorsed 的回答前面有 ✅，每条回复都有日期。没有这些标记，“只认老师的回复”就只是一句愿望，不是一条能执行的指令。

一条规则，放在三个地方

同学用 Study Kit 的方式不一样，所以这条规则放在三个地方：


  MCP 服务器的说明。 客户端连接时会读，所以同学什么都不用做，规则就生效。
  一个预设提示。 客户端输入框“+”菜单里的“作业要求”，填上作业名，它会读作业说明、评分细则和老师在 Ed 上的答疑，列出要交什么、怎么评分、截止时间和格式，以及 Ed 上的补充说明，每条都标出处。
  一个 agent skill。 skills/monash-study-kit/SKILL.md 给不用 MCP、直接调用 monash 命令行的编程 agent 用。它把常见问题对应到命令，带着同样的规则，并列出只能由同学自己做的事：登录、交作业、做测验、发帖。用 npx skills add Waldo0926/monash-study-kit 安装。


skill 里还直白地写了：帮同学理解作业要求，交上去的作业必须是自己做的，各门课关于 AI 使用的规定照样适用。

用测试让说明书保持准确

写给 agent 的说明书会悄悄过时。命令改了名，agent 就会去跑一个不存在的命令，再告诉同学出错了。所以有一个测试读 SKILL.md，拿真正的命令行程序来核对：

TABLE = sorted(set(re.findall(r"^\|.*`(monash [^`]+)` \|$", TEXT, re.M)))

@pytest.mark.parametrize("cmd", TABLE)
def test_every_command_parses(cmd):
    with redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
        args = cli.build_parser().parse_args(shlex.split(cmd)[1:])
    assert getattr(args, "fn", None)

def test_exit_codes_match_cli():
    rows = dict(re.findall(r"^\| (\d+) \| (.+) \|$", TEXT, re.M))
    assert sorted(map(int, rows)) == sorted(cli.EXIT_CODES)

def test_assignment_rules_and_limits():
    assert "brief and the marking rubric come first" in TEXT
    assert "Other students' replies are leads" in TEXT
    assert "Never ask for, accept or repeat an Ed token" in TEXT


skill 表格里的每条完整命令，都要能被真正的参数解析器解析。正文里提到的每个命令都必须存在。退出码表要和 EXIT_CODES 一致。规则里最关键的几句话也必须还在，免得哪次修改不小心删掉。

它保证不了的

这是给模型的指令，不是检查答案的代码。模型还是可能看错评分细则，或者漏掉某个帖子。这条规则改变的是同学拿到的东西：一分钟就能核对的出处和日期，来源不一致时一句明确的“去问老师”。

小结


  在模型看到资料之前，先告诉它哪个来源优先，并要求每条规定都标出处。
  “只信老师”这种指令，需要数据里本来就标着谁是老师。
  给 agent 的说明书要拿真正的程序来测，就像测文档里的示例一样。

title: A Q&A bot where the model is only allowed to quote
description: A WeChat bot answers students and parents about visas, exams and enrolment. Why the language model in it may only quote sentences, how the code checks every quote, and which true sentences it still refuses to send.
content:
The 马莫百科 bot answers questions from Monash Malaysia students and their parents on WeChat. Most answers come from rules: Q&As I taught it, the Monash Hub API, and the account’s own articles. Anything it cannot answer is forwarded to me.

The rules miss questions whose answer is sitting in those same sources, worded differently. So I added an optional RAG step that runs only when the rules found nothing or only a weak match. The rule I set for it: better “不知道” than a wrong procedure. A student who is told “I don’t know, I’ve passed it on” asks again. A student who is told the wrong visa deadline acts on it.

Letting the model write did not work

The first version let a free model answer in its own words from the retrieved passages. It read well and it was wrong in ways that matter. It added steps no passage has (“老师会替你申请特殊考虑”, the teacher will apply for special consideration for you). It turned “ISP 在贴纸剩 14 天或更少时收护照” (ISP collects passports when 14 days or fewer are left on the sticker) into “过期后有 14 天宽限期” (a 14-day grace period after expiry).

I tried a second model to check the first one’s sentences. It missed some of these and cut correct ones. A checker that is also a language model has the same problem as the writer.

The model picks sentences, the code checks them

So the model does not write anymore. The prompt asks it to copy sentences from the numbered passages without changing a character, at most four, one per line as [passage number] sentence, or to say “这个我不确定” when nothing answers the question.

Every line is then checked in code. The quote must be in the passage it names, with whitespace ignored, and at least six characters long:

def sentence(quote, h):
    text = h.text
    idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(text) if not c.isspace()]
    q = _squash(quote)
    at = "".join(text[i] for i in idx).find(q)
    if not q or at < 0:
        return None
    ...  # widen to the whole sentence it is in


A paraphrase, an added step, or a real sentence put on the wrong passage number all fail this check. A test feeds in exactly those three cases and expects nothing to be sent. What passes is widened to the whole sentence it sits in, so a half sentence never goes out on its own. The reply lists the pages the sentences come from, with links, and a line saying they are excerpts.

When the model says it is unsure, or none of its quotes survive, the question goes to me. A weak rule match (“你问的是不是…”) is held back too, because a confident guess about a different question is worse than “已转给作者”.

A true sentence can still mislead

Quoting exactly is not enough. One early reply quoted the renewal page:


  你必须在到期前四个月提交续签申请；并且


That sentence is on the page. But it sits under “如果你没有满足上述任何一项要求：” (if you meet none of the requirements above), so it only applies to some students. Without the line above it, the sentence tells everyone the wrong deadline.

So _why_not also drops sentences that need their surroundings to be read correctly:


  a list item under a heading that ends in a colon,
  a line ending in “；并且” or “：”,
  a line starting with “此流程” (this process) or with the “不，” that answers an FAQ question the reader cannot see,
  a table row without its header row,
  a sentence whose years are all in the past, such as last year’s exam dates.


Taught Q&As and the Hub’s FAQ are written for these students, so when they answer, a general web page is not mixed in next to them. An old page once said “你必须选择参加考核” (you must sit the assessment) right next to a taught answer saying you can skip it.

Malaysia is not Australia

Most people who ask are at the Malaysia campus, but many Monash pages are written for Australia. The Hub’s FAQ once said intermission “会改变你的 CoE”. A CoE is part of the Australian student visa and means nothing on a Malaysian Student Pass.

Each quote is now labelled by campus. A sentence from an Australian page, or one that mentions CoE, OSHC, ESOS or Centrelink, counts as Australian. Taught Q&As, the account’s articles and Malaysian pages count as Malaysian. Quotes are sorted Malaysia first, then all campuses, then Australia. When anything Australian is in the reply, the quotes get headings, so the Australian rule appears under “澳洲校区（澳大利亚的规定，马来西亚校区不一定一样）”. The taught Q&As for visas, insurance and study load now give both campuses separately, and a test fails any answer that mentions CoE, OSHC or subclass 500 without both labels.

How well it does

The evaluation runs 50 fixed questions through the rules alone and through rules plus RAG. A judge model compares each reply with the expected points. Round 8, on 2026-10-25 (docs/EVAL.md):


  
    
       
      Rules only
      Rules + RAG
    
  
  
    
      Correct, marked by the judge
      81% (34/42)
      88% (38/43)
    
    
      No-answer questions left to me
      14% (1/7)
      86% (6/7)
    
  


The second row is the one I care about. Seven questions have no answer in any source. The rules alone guessed at six of them. With RAG, six of the seven went to me.

The first row needs a warning. The judge only checks whether the expected points are there, so a reply with an extra wrong step can still be marked correct. That is the reason the quote check is in code and not in another model.

It runs on Groq’s free tier (qwen/qwen3.8-27b) and has been on in production since 2026-10-24. In round 8, 95% of replies took under a second, well inside WeChat’s 5-second limit. Answers are cached for seven days, so a repeated question does not call the model again. If the model is slow or down (the free tier answers 429 when several questions come at once), taught Q&As, the account’s articles and the Hub’s FAQ still answer. When the rules only have a weak match, the bot does not guess and the question comes to me.

What it still cannot do

The check makes sure every sentence sent is really on the page it links to. It cannot make sure that page is the right one for the question. When retrieval picks a passage about another situation, the model can quote it correctly and still not answer what was asked. That is why every reply links its pages and says it is an excerpt, and why questions it cannot answer still come to me.

title: 只许大模型摘原句的问答机器人
description: 一个在微信上回答同学和家长签证、考试、选课问题的机器人。为什么里面的大模型只能摘原句，程序怎么逐句核对，以及哪些句子明明是真的也不发。
content:
马莫百科机器人在微信上回答 Monash 马来西亚校区同学和家长的问题。大部分回答靠规则：我教过的问答、Monash Hub 的接口，还有公众号自己的文章。答不上来的转给我。

规则会漏掉一些问题：答案其实就在这些资料里，只是说法不一样。所以我加了一个可选的 RAG 步骤，只在规则没命中或只有弱命中时才用。我给它定的规矩是：宁可说不知道，也不能说错流程。同学收到“我还答不上来，已经转给作者”，会再问一次；收到一个错的签证截止日期，是会照着去做的。

让模型自己写，不行

第一版让免费模型根据检索到的片段自己组织回答。读起来很顺，但错在要命的地方。它会加上资料里没有的步骤，比如“老师会替你申请特殊考虑”；还把“ISP 在贴纸剩 14 天或更少时收护照”写成了“过期后有 14 天宽限期”。

我又试了用第二个模型检查第一个模型写的句子。它漏掉了一些，还删掉了一些对的。拿大模型去检查大模型，检查的那个也有同样的问题。

模型只挑句子，程序来核对

所以模型不再写回答。提示词要求它从编号的资料里原样摘句子，一个字都不能改，最多 4 句，每行写成 [资料编号] 原句；资料里没有能回答的，就只回“这个我不确定”。

每一行都由程序核对：去掉空白后，摘的句子必须是它标的那段资料的子串，而且至少 6 个字。

def sentence(quote, h):
    text = h.text
    idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(text) if not c.isspace()]
    q = _squash(quote)
    at = "".join(text[i] for i in idx).find(q)
    if not q or at < 0:
        return None
    ...  # 扩展到它所在的整句


改写过的句子、加出来的步骤、把真句子标错了资料编号，这三种都过不了。有一个测试专门喂这三种，要求一句都不发。通过的句子会扩展成它所在的整句，不会只发半句。回复下面列出句子来自哪些页面和链接，并注明是原文摘录。

模型说不确定，或者摘的句子一句都没通过，问题就转给我。这时规则的弱匹配（“你问的是不是…”）也不发：对另一个问题的瞎猜，比“已转给作者”更糟。

真句子也可能误导人

一字不差也不够。早期有一次回复摘了续签页面上的这句：


  你必须在到期前四个月提交续签申请；并且


页面上确实有这句话。但它写在“如果你没有满足上述任何一项要求：”下面，只适用于一部分同学。没有上面那一行，这句话就等于告诉所有人一个错的截止时间。

所以 _why_not 还会去掉离开上下文就会看错的句子：


  标题以冒号结尾的列表项；
  以“；并且”或“：”结尾的行；
  以“此流程”开头的行，或者以“不，”开头、回答的是一个读者看不到的 FAQ 问题的行；
  没有表头的表格行；
  里面的年份全都已经过去的句子，比如去年的考试日期。


教过的问答和 Hub 的 FAQ 是专门给这些同学写、核对过的，它们能回答时，不再在旁边混进一般网页的句子。以前就出现过一个旧页面写着“你必须选择参加考核”，旁边教过的问答说的却是可以不考。

马来西亚不是澳洲

来问的大多是马来西亚校区的同学，但 Monash 很多页面是写给澳洲校区的。Hub 的 FAQ 以前写过“休学会改变你的 CoE”。CoE 是澳洲学生签证的东西，对马来西亚的 Student Pass 没有意义。

现在每一句都按校区分类：来自澳洲校区页面的句子，或者提到 CoE、OSHC、ESOS、Centrelink 的句子，算澳洲；教过的问答、公众号文章和马来西亚校区页面算马来西亚。排序是马来西亚在前，各校区通用其次，澳洲最后。回复里只要有澳洲的句子，就加上小标题，澳洲的规定放在“澳洲校区（澳大利亚的规定，马来西亚校区不一定一样）”下面。签证、保险、修课量这些教过的问答也改成两个校区分开写；有个测试会检查，提到 CoE、OSHC 或 subclass 500 的回答，必须两个校区都标出来。

效果

评测用固定的 50 道题，分别只用规则、用规则加 RAG 回答，由一个裁判模型对照参考要点打分。第八轮是 2026-10-25 跑的（docs/EVAL.md）：


  
    
       
      只用规则
      规则 + RAG
    
  
  
    
      回答正确（裁判判）
      81%（34/42）
      88%（38/43）
    
    
      没有答案的题交给了我
      14%（1/7）
      86%（6/7）
    
  


我最看重第二行。有 7 道题在所有资料里都没有答案。只用规则时，其中 6 道它都瞎猜了一个回答；加上 RAG 后，7 道里有 6 道转给了我。

第一行要打个折扣。裁判只看参考要点有没有出现，回答里多一个错的步骤，照样可能判对。这也是为什么核对放在程序里，而不是再交给一个模型。

它用的是 Groq 的免费额度（qwen/qwen3.8-27b），2026-10-24 起在线上打开。第八轮里 95% 的回复不到 1 秒，远低于微信 5 秒的限制。回答缓存 7 天，同样的问题不会再调模型。模型慢了或者挂了（免费额度同时来几个问题就会返回 429），教过的问答、公众号文章和 Hub FAQ 照常发；规则只有弱匹配的话就不猜，转给我。

还做不到的

核对能保证发出去的每一句确实在它链接的页面上，但保证不了那个页面就是这个问题该看的。检索拿到一段讲别的情况的资料，模型摘得一字不差，也还是答非所问。所以每条回复都附上页面链接、注明是摘录，答不上来的问题也还是会转给我。
